cache_control.detail: The request may use top-level automatic cache_control or explicit cache_control on cacheable content blocks; type ephemeral is the only supported cache type.

cache_creation.detail: Provider-reported tokens written to a new cache entry; current detail may split 5-minute and 1-hour writes under usage.cache_creation, whose sum equals this field.

cache_read.detail: Provider-reported tokens retrieved from cache for this request.

eligibility.detail: Claude Sonnet 5 on the public Claude API requires at least 1024 cacheable prompt tokens. Shorter marked prompts are processed without an error; zero creation and zero read are the documented observation, not proof of an internal miss reason.

ttl.detail: Ephemeral entries default to five minutes and refresh without additional charge when used. ttl 1h requests a one-hour entry at the documented higher write price.

identity.detail: A successful Message has a body id. Every API response separately carries a unique request-id header. No one-to-one relationship beyond the retained response is inferred.

retry.detail: Official SDKs retry transient connection, rate-limit, and 5xx failures with exponential backoff twice by default and honor retry-after. The proposed probe disables automatic retries and permits one attempt for each of two equivalent requests per path.

token_accounting: total_input_tokens = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens; input_tokens is already the uncached suffix after the last breakpoint

fields.operation: dropped/unavailable in step-finish; runtime message and part IDs are not substitutes
